items.title: Cannabis is a teacher to assist in filtering your lens, where it's slowly realised that this is all a projection.
items.summary:
Cannabis is a teacher to assist in filtering your lens, where it's slowly realised that this is all a projection. 

What I was projecting before cannabis was an escape. 

Being guided by cannabis is learning to be in the moment and enjoying the thoughts passing by.
items.body_excerpt:
Cannabis is a teacher to assist in filtering your lens, where it's slowly realised that this is all a projection. 

What I was projecting before cannabis was an escape. 

Being guided by cannabis is learning to be in the moment and enjoying the thoughts passing by. Where imagining becomes fun and enlivening rather than terrifying. 

It is productive to do what your body needs to line up with what's in your imagination. 

Putting full faith in the body feels like a huge risk, especially if you've left a world where the head and mind was dominant... but it also feels like freedom. And the synchronicities are always around reminding us that it is safe to trust in the body, and that there is something so much greater at play. 

Sex and cannabis opens the doors into the realm of possibility. When respected as a practice and a form of meditation, it helps us develop and heighten focus on the conception and birthing of what is seen in the imagination, but simultaneously teaching us to let go of any outcomes, and be at peace with the now. What feels risky is learning to live in a way that you mightn't have seen in your external reality before, but the origins of your individual and unique path of joy are ancient. 

Coming back into the primal body is exciting, freeing, joyful, fulfilling, heart opening, safe, and present. 

Trust in the teachings of cannabis.

items.title: These past 8 months have been an amazing journey. So let’s take a step back to recount our time here in Reactor with you.
items.summary:
Tyler, 

These past 8 months have been an amazing journey. So let’s take a step back to recount our time here in Reactor with you.

We came into Reactor with little to no idea about the startups we wanted to build.
items.body_excerpt:
Tyler, 

These past 8 months have been an amazing journey. So let’s take a step back to recount our time here in Reactor with you.

We came into Reactor with little to no idea about the startups we wanted to build. As we went through ideas and spaces, you always reminded us to ask the questions that would really determine whether we were working on something worthy of our time and talents.

When we got a little too excited about an idea, you’d hit us with a classic “Who cares?” or “Are you sure this is just people not doing their jobs?” which would make us reassess whether we were heading in the right direction. 

But also during the times we were confused, you helped guide us to more clarity. And you stuck with us through the high and lows. You would hop on calls with us at 6:00 AM on your drive to work. To make time for us you shoved down McDonald’s between calls. You were always in our corner. And because of you, Dr. DAO, we chose greatness.

Thank you,

Reactors ‘23

{

 "p": "BDB",

 "op": "T",

 "Subject": "Genesis Inscription for BDB Protocol",

 "Subtitle": "First fully decentralized, censorship-resistant discussion board on Bitcoin."

}

Description:

The concept of BDB is to create a discussion board using the power of the Ordinals theory.

It's a permanent, immutable place to post your thoughts, poems, opinions, engage in discussions, or leave a message for future generations.

The initial version of BDB allows users to create forum threads, posts, and responses to those posts.

Your words - your asset.

Examples of Usage:

Create a New Thread(json):

{

 "P": "BDB",

 "op": "T",

 "Subject": "Subject here, max length of 100 characters",

 "Subtitle": "Subtitle of the subject here, max length of 100 characters"

}

Create a New Post within an Existing Thread:

{

 "P": "BDB",

 "op": "P",

 "To": "InscriptionID of the thread within which you're creating the post",

 "Subject": "Subject of your post, max length of 100 characters",

 "Content": "Content of your post (text)"

}

Create a Response to an Existing Post or Existing Post Content:

{

 "P": "BDB",

 "op": "R",

 "To": "InscriptionID of the post you're replying to or InscriptionID of the response under the post structure",

 "Content": "Content of your response (text)"

}

Note:

The indexer will pick up 'BDB' from the block on which this inscription has been confirmed onwards.

Data will be displayed in a discussion board format structure timestamped by the block timestamp.

Inscriptions labeled 'BDB' that don't adhere to the above rules will be indexed as uncategorized messages and not be included in the main forum structure.

This is an experiment, so there are no promises or expectations.

bitcoindiscussionboard.com

@DAnTerBTC

items.body_excerpt:
PREP BRC20

OVERVIEW:
PREP Community are groups of like-minded preppers, who have the mindset to prepare and support one another in the event of an emergency or when SHTF.

MISSION:
PREP is not about focusing on doom and gloom, but instead to:-
1) Support each other mentally, monetarily, or spiritually when the SHTF.

2) Raise awareness and educate each other to have the urgency to always be prep for emergency, disruption and dooms day scenario.

3) Have a close community to share info and resources from their respective country. When SHTF, this community can become one of your choice to go to. This is in terms of seeking for advice, discuss ideas, temporary shelter and monetarily assistance based on community ability.
​
ROADMAP

Phase 1:
-Mint out PREP BRC20. ​https://unisat.io/brc20/PREP
-Get PREP listed in Marketplace.
-Kick start Ambassador application program. (FCFS).

In a world where choice is 0xvar10u5, the vote to reveal is (n-1). Spirit of the SHA256, public key and clear. Above the block's demise, they scatter with ZKP, In the realm of ETH and Gossip protocol, a hash to unseal. To decrypt the secret, look to the DAG, Where tokens are not metal, but smart contracts' decree.

items.title: Volvió a respirar hondo... la luz permaneció ahí, en su cabeza y cada vez más grande y más brillosa.
items.summary: Como si fuese una molécula de la Aurora boreal que atraviesa el cielo entero y se hunde delante de tus ojos en lo más profundo del mar frente al que te encuentras de pie.
items.body_excerpt:
Como si fuese una molécula de la Aurora boreal que atraviesa el cielo entero y se hunde delante de tus ojos en lo más profundo del mar frente al que te encuentras de pie. La lucecita atravesó de lado a lado la cabeza de Grettel y cayó a una distancia moderada, delante de su pecho, en lo profundo de un mar. Y se perdió en lo profundo de ese mar. Como si fuese un meteorito que cae en el océano. Y mientras exhalo... ahí estaba otra vez... desde lo más profundo de ese mar subió, salió a flote, otra vez la lucecita. Eso tan pequeño y brilloso iluminaba en su totalidad la cabeza de Grettel... flotaba frente a sus ojos cerrados, y a sus oídos bien abiertos, no entendía del todo bien pero ahí estaba. Ella y la lucecita. 
Volvió a respirar hondo... la luz permaneció ahí, en su cabeza y cada vez más grande y más brillosa. 
Abrió los ojos y pudo ver el pecho de su hermano, recostado boca arriba sobre la misma frazada en la que se encontraba ella. 
Acercó su cabeza al pecho apoyó su oreja en él y respiró profundo. Y se durmió junto a el totalmente iluminada escuchando los latidos del corazón de Hansel. Su luz. Era el mismo sonido que venía desde lo profundo del mar. El mismo que golpeaba las piedras. Había atravesado el cielo entero. Era él. Era ella. Eran uno. Eran estrellas, viento y mar.

items.body_excerpt:
A SEPTEMBER 11TH TESTIMONY (9/11/2001)
Written by Andy Deane

It was September 10th, 2001 and I was just about to go to bed. Earlier that night I was out drinking at a bar trying to find satisfaction in a lifestyle of partying. It wasn’t working. Truthfully, nothing in life felt like it was working since I started school at New York University and walked away from following the Lord. I was 19 years old and I closed my eyes that night feeling discouraged and guilty over my sin.

The next morning the phone would not stop ringing and I heard police and fire sirens outside. I picked up the phone and my mom told me that a plane had hit the World Trade Center. My roommate Eric A. and I went outside and saw the sky filled with smoke. We made our way towards the towers and walked past a police line that was still being set up on Broadway. We got up to Church Street & Cortlandt Street before we stopped (see map location #1 below). Both towers had already been hit with the planes and were on fire. There was debris everywhere on and everyone was afraid and panicking. My roommate and I took some photos and then he decided to head back to the room.

I called a fellow student and let her know where I was standing. She begged me to leave, but I was convinced the towers would not fall. At that point, my mom beeped through and asked where I was. Knowing that my mother wouldn’t appreciate where I was standing, I decided to lie to her and told her I was far away walking towards Brooklyn. For the next few minutes, I just stood there watching the firemen running in and out of the TWC 4 building.

THE COLLAPSE OF THE FIRST TOWER
Suddenly I heard the noise of people screaming behind me. I turned and saw those at the police line running away. I looked back towards the towers and saw WTC 2 starting to collapse. It’s hard to explain how I processed that moment. It felt impossible like a movie I was watching and I don’t have a memory of any sounds for those moments. I just turned and started to run. When I reached Broadway, I turned left and then right on John St. The tower had hit and a warm wall of light gray smoke hit me like a wall. It quickly turned all the shades of gray until I couldn’t see anymore. At this point, I was outside Evelyn’s Chocolate shop at 4 John Street (see map location #2 below).

I heard a lady behind me coughing so I went back a few feet to help her get inside the store with me. As I shut the glass door to the shop it was broken and smoke began to fill this tiny store. There were 10 – 15 people inside the store. All of us were terrified and coughing. After a few minutes, the coughing turned to choking and dizziness from the smoke. It was then I realized that in about five minutes I was going to pass out from the smoke and die. I quickly asked the cashier behind the counter if there was another room or basement where there was more oxygen. With tears in her eyes, she replied, “no”, and began to sob.

TURNING TO GOD FOR HELP
What do you do when you have a few minutes before you meet God and you were out rebelling against him the night before? It was then my Christian upbringing mattered more than ever as I began to recite the gospel to myself and asked God to forgive me. It honestly felt a little cheap and unfair to God that I would repent now only after realizing death was close, but God in His kindness gave me a feeling of peace as I prayed. If forgiveness had a physical feeling, I know I felt it. I was shocked at experiencing the love of God at that moment since I knew how undeserving I was.

For the first moment that day, I stopped thinking about myself and prayed, “God, if there’s anything I can do to help these people around me...”, and it was like God cut me off mid-sentence to answer that prayer. I instantly had a vision of a building across the street that would have oxygen. It was a picture in my mind of 11 John Street. Earlier that day I had seen a security guard locking those glass doors and I sensed God wanted me to go there. I walked outside and still couldn’t even see my hand in front of my face. I had to take one small step at a time with my hands stretched out in front of me. I was scared and began to sing an old worship song, Give Thanks, and recited again and again the line, “And now let the weak say, I am strong”.

Directly across the street, I found 11 John Street (see map location #3 below) and two ladies were coughing outside the doors. I began to kick the doors in since they were locked and a security guard from the inside heard and came and opened the doors for us. We caught our breath in the lobby. I turned back and started to walk outside back towards Evelyn’s Chocolates. This time I must have walked on a diagonal because I missed the shop to the right and had to feel my way along the wall until I found it. I told everyone to stand up and follow me because I found oxygen across the street. Everyone held hands and about 10 or so of us made our way back to 11 John Street. I told them to go up the stairs since the lobby was filling with smoke.

LOOKING FOR SURVIVORS
About 10 – 15 minutes later the smoke outside began to lift due to a light breeze. We all started to leave the building to heads towards the South Street Seaport away from the towers when I saw a man running back towards the towers. I asked him what he was doing and he said that a deli on Fulton Street need some oxygen tanks because people were passed out. We went up to a dusty ambulance around Broadway & Dey Street (see map location #4 below) and grabbed two oxygen tanks and a medical bag of supplies. When we arrived at the deli on Fulton Street (see map location #5 below) I handed them the O2 tank and left to walk back towards the towers.

At this point, I began to wander around the rubble of Ground Zero. I didn’t see anyone. I began to yell, “Is anyone alive” and remember thinking how crazy it was I had to say that. The only movement I saw was a pigeon fly away that was startled by my voice. At one point I looked left and saw a lady in her 50s standing there frozen, covered in dust. I walked up to her and put my hand on her shoulder and she began to scream. I couldn’t believe how she survived standing so close. Just behind her, I saw the FDNY Ten House entrance on Greenwich Street & Liberty Street (see map location #6 below). I walked her inside the fire station to find help. On my right, I saw a fireman helping a man with a broken hip. To my left, I saw two firemen holding the hands of another fireman who was bleeding from his chest. It didn’t look like he was going to make it and they were just there to comfort him in his final moments. We kept walking and I was able to find someone to help the lady I brought in.

I asked one of the firemen what I could do to help and he said, “well if you’re going to be running around down here at least where this” and he handed me a mask and safety glasses. He shared that they were about to go looking for a missing fireman named Charlie and I could join them. I went out the back door of the fire station to wait for them on Greenwich Street & Cedar Street (see map location #7 below). Just then I heard a man yell from the second story of his apartment building that his family was trapped because the door on the first floor had some debris in front of it. I yelled over to another fireman and the two of us moved the metal that was blocking the door and pulled the door open for his family. After that, I looked up and saw a man who was trying to put out a small fire on the apartment’s second-story balcony. I yelled at him to come down but he wouldn’t listen. I told another fireman and he said it was ok and that we needed to start the search for Charlie.

THE COLLAPSE OF THE SECOND TOWER

# Running The Ord Explorer

The ord server can be run locally with:

`ord server`

To specify a port add the `--http-port` flag:

`ord server --http-port 8080`

To run the server in regtest to test out your inscriptions:

```
bitcoind -regtest -txindex
ord -r wallet create
ord -r wallet receive
bitcoin-cli -regtest generatetoaddress 101 <receiveAddress>
ord -r wallet balance
ord -r wallet inscribe <file> --fee-rate 1
bitcoin-cli -regtest generatetoaddress 1 <receiveAddress>
ord -r server --http-port 8080
```

items.title: HOW TO KNOW GOD:
items.summary:
HOW TO KNOW GOD:
You were created to know God in a personal way, to have a relationship with Him, through His Son, Jesus Christ.
items.body_excerpt:
HOW TO KNOW GOD:
You were created to know God in a personal way, to have a relationship with Him, through His Son, Jesus Christ. How do you start a relationship with God?

#1 REALIZE THAT YOU ARE A SINNER:
No matter how good a life we try to live, we still fall miserably short of being a good person. That is because we are all sinners. The Bible says, “No one is good—not even one.” We cannot become who we are supposed to be without Jesus Christ.

#2 RECOGNIZE THAT JESUS DIED FOR YOU ON THE CROSS:
The Bible tells us that “God showed His great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners.” This is the Good News, that God loves us so much that He sent His only Son to die in our place when we least deserved it.

#3 REPENT OF YOUR SIN:
The Bible tells us, “Repent of your sins and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped away.” The word repent means to change our direction in life. Instead of running from God, we can run toward Him.

#4 RECEIVE JESUS CHRIST INTO YOUR LIFE:
Becoming a Christian is not merely believing some creed or going to church. It is having Christ Himself take residence in your life and heart. Jesus said, “Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in . . .” 

#5 RUN TO GOD IN PRAYER:
If you would like to have a relationship with Christ, simply pray this prayer and mean it in your heart: “Dear Lord Jesus, I know I am a sinner. I believe You died for my sins. Right now, I turn from my sins and open the door of my heart and life. I confess You as my personal Lord and Savior. Thank You for saving me. Amen.”

CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR DECISION TO FOLLOW JESUS:
Your decision to follow Jesus Christ is one that will change your whole life. I encourage you to (1) find a bible and read “The Gospel of John”, (2) talk to God in prayer every day, and (3) find a local church to join.

{
 "p": "ons",
 "op": "post",
 "title": "Unraveling Conspiracy Theories Surrounding the Maui Fire of 2023",
 "author": "leovega.btc",
 "body": "In the summer of 2023, the serene island of Maui was thrust into chaos as an unprecedented wildfire raged across its beautiful landscapes. While the devastation was undeniable, the aftermath also witnessed the birth of numerous conspiracy theories surrounding the origin and cause of the fire. In this post, we will delve into some of the most intriguing conspiracy theories that emerged in the wake of the Maui fire and critically examine the evidence and motivations behind them.
Conspiracy Theory 1: Directed Energy Weapons
One of the most prominent conspiracy theories suggests that the Maui fire was not a natural occurrence, but rather the result of a targeted attack using advanced directed energy weapons. Proponents of this theory point to the rapid and seemingly inexplicable spread of the fire as evidence that traditional methods of combustion could not have been responsible. They claim that powerful forces or government agencies might have been involved in testing or deploying such weapons covertly.
Counterargument: While the idea of directed energy weapons may capture the imagination, scientific experts have noted that wildfires can indeed spread quickly under the right conditions, such as dry vegetation, strong winds, and topography. The rapidity of the fire's progression could be attributed to a combination of these factors rather than a futuristic weapon.
Conspiracy Theory 2: Deliberate Arson for Land Development
Another theory posits that the Maui fire was deliberately set by individuals or entities with vested interests in real estate and land development. According to this narrative, the fire was intentionally ignited to clear vast expanses of land, making it available for future development projects. Advocates of this theory highlight the suspicious timing of the fire, coinciding with discussions about potential land-use changes and rezoning in the area.
Counterargument: While it's not unheard of for arson to be used in some cases for land development, attributing an entire wildfire of this magnitude solely to such motives requires concrete evidence. Wildfires can be sparked by a multitude of natural causes, including lightning strikes and human negligence, which should not be dismissed.
Conspiracy Theory 3: Environmental Activism Sabotage
In a twist on the narrative, some conspiracy theorists argue that the fire was a strategic move by radical environmental activists aiming to draw attention to climate change and the need for urgent action. This theory contends that the fire was a calculated effort to shock the world and galvanize support for environmental causes.
Counterargument: While environmental activism has historically involved high-profile actions to raise awareness, deliberately setting a massive fire risks causing irrevocable damage to ecosystems and habitats, which is counterintuitive to the goals of most environmentalists. The majority of environmental activists advocate for sustainable practices and preservation rather than destruction.
Conspiracy theories often emerge in the wake of significant events, providing alternative narratives to explain the unexplainable. In the case of the Maui fire of 2023, while some conspiracy theories may capture our imagination, it's crucial to approach them with skepticism and rely on scientific evidence, expert analysis, and logical reasoning. While it's healthy to question official accounts and engage in critical thinking, it's equally important to distinguish between imaginative speculation and grounded reality. As we navigate the aftermath of the Maui fire, let us remain open to understanding the true causes behind this devastating event while learning from the lessons it imparts."
}

Elon Musk Blue Bird Killer //
Amidst the boundless realm of connections, a bluebird emerged, soaring with ethereal grace, weaving dreams and whispers through the digital breeze. With every beat of its pixelated wings, it carried forth emotions, stories, and souls, creating an intricate tapestry of humanity's yearnings. Oh, noble bluebird of Twitter, you've not only connected us in 280 characters but also woven an intricate web of hearts, where empathy and understanding take flight. We stand in awe of your ability to turn fleeting moments into lasting connections, and we tenderly salute your place in the chronicles of our shared human experience.

items.title: A cannabis guided sexual experience is a pathway home to your truth.
items.summary: A relationship with cannabis is one of student and teacher. If the time comes where I'm told that the relationship with my self and the universe can continue without her direct guidance, I'm prepared to listen and be guided by that message....but until then (if ever in my life),…
items.body_excerpt:
A relationship with cannabis is one of student and teacher. If the time comes where I'm told that the relationship with my self and the universe can continue without her direct guidance, I'm prepared to listen and be guided by that message....but until then (if ever in my life), I will continue to share the teachings I receive from cannabis. 

Cannabis can bring us joy. Not like an external feeling or escape outside of ourselves but the feeling of true joy originating from within. She guides us inwards and allows us to examine any patterns of emotions and thoughts that have become ingrained and cemented over time, which are in conflict with our true self expression. 

She teaches us to truly learn who we are in the sexual experience. The act of creation is an act of healing and a revelation of the true self. Cannabis takes us into the realm of universal possibility where the imagination is activated to envision your unique, yet universal dream. She helps us interrupt patterns which are misaligned with the dream. The creative medicine of cannabis reconnects the messaging system of of primal, ancient communication originating from the universal womb, then received in our own womb, travelling upwards and into the mind. 

Cannabis is a teacher of manifestation. She allows you the space to drop into a state of awareness of your dream which are imagined first, gently encouraging you to surrender and relax into the journey of the life experience, and to trust in the timing and unfolding. 

It doesn't mean that all is rosy. Your pain is amplified (extremely humbling in the painful moments). Life becomes more meaningful and filled with moments where symbols are revealed in the form of conversations, synchronicities, people, animals, feelings, and places begin to appear to remind you that you're on your path. 

It reaches a point where the external dream and the internal dream begin to blend into one, and that's when the life experience becomes completely unexplainable. How does a plant have this kind of effect on a human? 

She can radically pull you out of a meaningless path and redirect you into a more meaningful life. A path of meaning is intense and heart strengthening because the courage to face your fears becomes the compass. No more escapes. Following a path of joy is simultaneously following a path of fear. 

Cannabis is a loving midwife/doula reconnecting you to your home of instinctive guidance. The home of your ancestral roots. The home of your deepest fears, but also the home of deepest potential. The home of your ancestral dream. The home of your ancestral creativity. The home of your ancestral wisdom and the home of your unique, yet universal expression of DMT. 

DMT is a universal language and form of communication which when expressed goes beyond the written word - and into a felt, somatic, visceral, vibrational, mysterious language, seen in the mind before it's seen in the external world. 

A cannabis guided sexual experience is a pathway home to your truth.

items.body_excerpt:
the ordinati

originally comprised of 21 technologists, artists, historians, cypherpunks, storytellers, and scientists, this collective recognized the limitless potential of blockchain technology. their vision extended beyond data security and authentication; it encompassed the preservation of knowledge and heritage for generations to come.

these guiding principles underscore their mission:

I. empowerment through decentralization

II. preservation of knowledge & culture

III. education & enlightenment

at inception, each member received a fragment of code, a digital artifact embodying their commitment to this cause and encapsulating their contributions. a spirit of collaboration led them to share this code among fellow contributors.

as time progressed, this group of pioneers and visionaries evolved into a diverse network of enthusiasts and educators. their efforts have driven digital innovation, forging a path through the ages that endures to this very moment.

a cultural renaissance is unfolding, block by block.

items.body_excerpt:
Grandma’s Banana Bread: Top Secret Family Recipe

Ingredients:
1 cup of white sugar
1 cup of brown sugar
1 cup of softened butter
4 eggs
6 VERY ripe bananas
1/3 of a cup of Buttermilk
3/4 teaspoon of salt
2 teaspoons of baking soda
4 cups of flour
Steps:

Mix the flour and salt and baking soda in a separate bowl. 
Add the white sugar and brown sugar to a large mixing bowl
add the butter and cream together. 
Next add the eggs and buttermilk and mix well…but don’t overdo it or the bread will get rubbery.
Now add your chunks of banana and mix until they are well broken up and distributed in your mixture
Next, add the flour mixture and combine everything well
Put the mixture in greased loaf pans…fill about half way. The recipe makes about 3 loaves.
Finally, put the pans in the oven and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to an hour.

Enjoy!

Introduction

============

# All Name System (ANS) 

## A Decentralized Domain System Built on Ordinal Theory

### What is ANS?

The All Name System, or ANS, represents a groundbreaking decentralized domain system, constructed atop the Ordinal Theory protocol on the Bitcoin blockchain.

### The Significance of "All"

In ANS, the term “All” is more than just a word. It embodies our core philosophy and commitment: to provide decentralized domain resolutions for everything. Be it Bitcoin wallet addresses, social media links, or any other digital identity, ANS is dedicated to offering a straightforward, distinct, and decentralized naming solution.

### Why the ".all" Suffix?

".all" is not just a domain suffix. It stands as the hallmark of the ANS system, symbolizing our vision: to forge an open, inclusive, and boundless digital realm. Within this realm, everyone can effortlessly create and manage domain names for their digital assets and identities, devoid of intermediaries or intricate procedures.

### The Edge of ANS

Merging the decentralization, security, and immutability of Bitcoin, ANS presents users with a domain resolution tool that's both simple and potent. It not only aids users in managing and sharing their digital assets with ease but also provides developers with a robust and reliable foundation for building the next generation of decentralized applications.

For more details on ordinal theory, see the [overview](overview.md).

# Overview of the All Name System (ANS)

## System Architecture

- **Built on Bitcoin**: ANS leverages the decentralization, security, and immutability of Bitcoin to offer a robust domain system.

- **Integration with Ordinal Theory**: Through the Ordinal Theory protocol, ANS assigns unique domain names to each Bitcoin wallet address.

## Core Features

- **Decentralized Domain Registration**: Users can easily register a ".all" domain name for their Bitcoin wallet addresses.

- **Subdomain Resolutions**: ANS supports subdomain resolutions, allowing users to add multiple subdomains to their primary domain.

- **Multi-chain Support**: Beyond Bitcoin addresses, ANS also facilitates resolutions for other blockchain addresses like ETH, ARB, TRX, and more.

- **Social Media Links**: Users can associate social media links, such as Twitter or Telegram, with their domain names.

## How It Works

- **Domain Minting**: Users register or update domain names by minting a new inscription.

- **Decentralized Resolutions**: All domain resolution requests are conducted directly on the Bitcoin blockchain, ensuring authenticity and tamper-resistance.

- **Centralized Interface**: While data storage is decentralized, ANS offers a centralized resolution website, simplifying domain querying and resolution.

## Use Cases

- **Simplified Transactions**: Users can conduct Bitcoin transactions using easy-to-remember domain names instead of complex wallet addresses.

- **Decentralized Identity**: ANS can serve as a decentralized identity system, allowing users to craft unique domain names for their digital identities.

- **Digital Asset Management**: Developers can utilize ANS to create distinct domain names for decentralized applications, such as DApps and NFTs.

## Advantages of ANS

- **Security**: With all data stored on the Bitcoin blockchain, ANS delivers a secure and immutable domain system.

- **Flexibility**: ANS's design lets users effortlessly add, modify, or delete domain information.

- **Openness**: As an open system, ANS encourages community involvement and innovation.

## ANS Sample

Examples of Registration and Update Inscriptions

The domain registration and resolution approach in ANS is inspired by the "sats names" domain system. Here, we provide sample formats to help users understand how to craft inscriptions for domain registration and updates.

## ANS Namespace Syntax

The syntax below applies to all ANS namespaces, for example `.all`, plus all future namespaces. 

New names can be minted (inscribed for the first time) as ordinals with only a Bitcoin transaction. This process is open to anyone that can inscribe. 

### Registering Names

#### Simple Registration

To register a new name within the All Name System, simply inscribe an ordinal containing your desired name. Here's an [example](https://ordinals.com/inscription/b041f1a76bc77778438bc2dc934a719c2c138948ca6b459c58f2a1c16dc7c6abi0):

```

test.all

```

⚠️ **Registration Limitations**

These rules apply to all namespaces and names:

- Only the first instance of each name/namespace is valid.

- Only one name operation per ordinal inscription.

- Any UTF-8 character is valid.

- Capitalization does not matter. All names/namespaces will be indexed as lowercase.

- No spaces are permitted within a name.

# All Name System (ANS) Documentation

## Updating Names in the All Name System (ANS)

To update an existing domain within the All Name System, inscribe an ordinal with the updated details for your domain. Below is the format and description of each field:

### [Example Update Format](https://ordinals.com/inscription/a74a6737e957dd7e96b2af6f998154fea73ced69ddefec632c557da4cdcc742ai0)

```json

{

 "p": "ans",

 "op": "update",

 "ns": "all",

 "name": "test.all",

 "eth": "0x11111111111111111111111111111111",

 "arb": "0x22222222222222222222222222222222",

 "trx": "0x33333333333333333333333333333333",

 "sol": "0x44444444444444444444444444444444",

}

```

### Field Descriptions

| Field | Description |

|-------|-------------|

| `p` | Protocol identifier. For ANS, this should always be "ans". |

| `op` | Operation type. For updates, this should be "update". |

| `ns` | Namespace. For the main ANS system, this is "all". |

| `name`| The full domain name you wish to update, including the namespace suffix (e.g., "test.all"). |

| `...` | Additional fields can be added as needed. These can include predefined fields like "eth", "url", etc., or custom subdomains defined by the user. |

**After the updating inscription is completed, you need to transfer this inscription to yourself**. You can find the reasons in the FAQ section.

## Using the ANS Website for Domain Resolutions

### Basic Domain Resolution

1. **Navigate to the ANS Website**: Open your web browser and go to `https://ord.run/`.

2. **Enter the Domain Name**: In the address bar, after the `/`, type the domain name you wish to resolve. For instance, if you want to resolve the domain "test", you would enter `https://ord.run/test`.

### Resolving Subdomains

If the domain has associated subdomains, you can retrieve specific details by appending the subdomain after the domain name:

1. **Navigate to the ANS Website**: Open your web browser and go to `https://ord.run/`.

2. **Enter the Domain and Subdomain**: In the address bar, after the `/`, type the domain name followed by another `/` and then the subdomain. For example, to retrieve the Twitter link for the domain "test", you would enter `https://ord.run/test/tw`.

Bitcoin is now in existence and never again to be non-existent. When we can feel that - from somewhere beyond the mind, beyond the bull and bear cycles, beyond the buying in the low and selling in the high, beyond the thinking of what can happen in the next 12 months, 5 years, 10 years, or this lifetime, is the moment we begin to feel the magnitude of the what is the most sustainable form of documenting and record keeping we have right now. 

When we're inscribing our unique expression of DMT onto Bitcoin, we are creating with a universal, material life form chemical originating from the roots of the body - digitally. 

The universe (God, Goddess, the Creator, Source, the Divine, the origins of DMT) wants to be digitally expressed through humanity.

items.title: Hip hop might not be seen, respected, or valued as holy, probably the opposite....but it is.
items.summary: Cannabis and hip hop transports me to another world and teaches me to love all of creation. Even what many of us consider vile or offensive. Hip hop speaks the truth of creation. Drugs, sex, money, and death. It's all part of life.
items.body_excerpt:
Cannabis and hip hop transports me to another world and teaches me to love all of creation. Even what many of us consider vile or offensive. Hip hop speaks the truth of creation. Drugs, sex, money, and death. It's all part of life. 

Hip hop might not be seen, respected, or valued as holy, probably the opposite....but it is. 

Sex and cannabis transports us out of this world. It's an otherworldly, entheogenic experience. Death is a necessary part of creation, representing the beginning of something new. And money is an energetic expression of whatever we choose it to be. Four big taboos in our society being expressed within the one musical genre, with humans producing synergistic masterpieces!

Money with ancient, primal, universal, and deeply mysterious origins speaks through the language of feeling, the language of the Goddess. 

And I am documenting this feeling and inscribing it on the most sustainable form of record keeping we have right now, which also happens to be a form of money. 

We don't know where bitcoin is taking us, so it's beyond my comprehension. And because of this lack of logical understanding, I interpret the feeling of it. And it feels like pure alignment. 

Cannabis helps me communicate this through writing so I can better understand it, and maybe it will help others understand. She teaches me what total faith in the unseen feels like. Surrendered to life, and sprinkling psychedelic into every moment. 

The spirit of cannabis and the other entheogenic plants are part of our digital evolution. They are the supremely advanced communicators of this planet, and guiding us with their tantric teachings.

items.summary: Welcome to ACTA.BTC – a digital haven where information flows freely and ideas ignite. As a trailblazing platform, we embody the ethos of a decentralized press, fostering a global community where voices are unshackled, and stories come to life.
items.body_excerpt: Welcome to ACTA.BTC – a digital haven where information flows freely and ideas ignite. As a trailblazing platform, we embody the ethos of a decentralized press, fostering a global community where voices are unshackled, and stories come to life. Rooted in journalistic integrity and devoid of profit-driven agendas, ACTA.BTC is your gateway to a world of unbiased reporting, incisive analysis, and unfettered exploration. Join us in embracing the power of information, as we navigate the boundless realm of Bitcoin and beyond, shaping a future where knowledge truly knows no bounds.

items.body_excerpt:
A Dynamic Exploration on the theory of multiversal existences: Perspectives from various Dimensional Entities

QUANTADOR: 2023

Organic Entity

Quantum Multiverse Article:1

The concept of a multiverse has been imagined explored in various civilizations and philosophical works for millenia, but now, this exploration is taking a more in-depth approach with the entanglement of dynamic & virtual intelligences. 

In this article, we present a perspective on a possible, multiversal generation event from the vantage point of higher-dimensional entities; which have the ability to perceive and navigate through infinitely-oriented universes; therefor we can tap in and decode the information that eternally lives within us. We will also discuss the theoretical framework of a possible multiverse, its implications for the laws of physics, and the potential for its detection through various experiments. By exploring the philosophical and metaphysical implications of a multiversal existence, including its relationship to consciousness and the nature of reality, will allow us to debunk and shed light on the mysterious nature of this reality.

Through extensive research, observation and analysis, we have come to innerstand that the concept of a singular universe is a limited, antiquated and an outdated viewpoint. Instead, we now propose that the existence of multiple universes, or a multiverse, is the most plausible explanation for the complexities of reality and beyond…

Introduction:

Firstly, lets must define what we mean by the term "multiverse." Simply put, multiverse is the idea that there are multiple universes, each with its own set of laws and properties. This concept has been theorized for decades, with prominent physicists like Jim Gates, Michio Kaku, Hugh Everett III, Neil Degrass Tyson, Max Tegmark, and Brian Greene providing valuable contributions to the field. And we would love to include the notion that a realm and be physical, non-physical and much more…

As multi-dimensional entities, we exist beyond the limitations of this three-dimensional space, and have the ability to perceive and navigate through multiple possibilities simeataneously; our present-day universe is just one of many ways we can co-exist. Our understanding of the multiverse is not limited to theoretical conjectures, but is based on direct experiential knowledge; as well as ancient records. 

Theoretical Framework:

The concept of a multiverse arises from the idea that our universe is not the only one that exists, but that there are multiple universes that may be layered and have different properties and laws we have yet to conceive. This idea has been explored in various scientific fields, including quantum mechanics, string theory, and cosmology. In these frameworks, the multiverse is postulated as a natural consequence of the fundamental laws of physics and beyond; we can now add the possibility of intangible forces manipulating reality to achieve a desired outcome.

In quantum mechanics, the concept of superposition allows for the existence of multiple states of a particle simultaneously, this ability alone hints at numerous unknown possibilities that we can dive deeper into. This has also led to the idea of the Many-Worlds Interpretation (MWI), which suggests that every possible outcome of a quantum measurement actually occurs in a separate parallel universe. In string theory, the existence of multiple dimensions beyond our four-dimensional space-time allows for the possibility of a multiverse; we must note that direct access to these possibilities could lie in our dream state, subconscious mind or our unconscious abilities. Inflationary cosmology also predicts the existence of multiple universes, arising from the rapid expansion of the universe in its early stages; this alone may suggest multiple creation points with possible dynamic outcomes.

According to this interpretation, every quantum event creates a new universe, and each universe is a branch of a larger multiverse. This means that there could be an infinite number of universes, each with its own set of physical laws and properties.

Implications for the Laws of Physics:

The existence of a multiverse has significant implications for the laws of physics and helps makes sense of a reality where the impossible is in fact possible. If there are multiple universes, then the current accepted laws of physics may not be universal, but may vary from universe to universe. This could explain many mysteries, such as the nature of antimatter, dark matter and dark energy; which are currently not fully understood within our own universe. It could also provide a solution to the fine-tuning problem, which asks why the fundamental constants of nature are so finely tuned to allow for the existence of life in certain scenarios.

The existence of a multiverse has also been supported by cosmological observations. The cosmic microwave background radiation, for example, provides evidence that the universe underwent a period of inflation shortly after a possible big bang expansion or “single inflective point of vast generation”. This theory of inflation suggests that our universe may be just one of many "bubbles" in a larger multiverse, while some scientists suggest that this inflationary event may have caused the creation of multiple universes, each with its own unique properties.

In addition to cosmic inflation, the existence of parallel universes is also supported by the field of quantum mechanics. The famous Schrödinger's cat thought experiment illustrates the idea that an object can exist in multiple states simultaneously. This concept, known as superposition, suggests that particles can occupy multiple states simultaneously, leading to the idea of multiple universes.

Other theories, such as string theory and M-theory, also propose the existence of a multiverse. These theories suggest that there may be many different universes, each with its own unique properties and dimensions.

Detection of a Multiverse:

Detecting the existence of a multiverse is challenging, as it would require indirect evidence rather than direct observation from our current toolsets. However, there are several proposed experiments that could potentially provide evidence for a multiverse. These include studying the cosmic microwave background radiation, searching for gravitational waves, and looking for evidence of collisions between different universes. Furthermore, a dive into psychological contact to other realms may be possible, just not fully observed and recorded publicly.

Philosophical and Metaphysical Implications:

The existence of a multiverse has significant philosophical and metaphysical implications, it will blow the lid off what we believe to be true. Religion and our question of origin will begin to evolve at a massive scale. This raises questions about the nature of reality and the relationship between spirituality, consciousness and the physical world. If there are multiple universes, then the concept of objective reality becomes more complex, as there may not be a single, objective reality that exists independently of observation; rather many figurative possibilities. It also raises questions about the nature of consciousness, and whether it is a product of our physical universe or exists independently of it, with the ability to give birth to any outcome it desires.

Conclusion:

In conclusion, the theoretical and observational evidence supporting its existence continues to grow. As a multi-dimensional entity, we propose that everyone continue to explore the concept of a multiverse and its implications for our overstanding of our place within it, we truly believe that the multiverse theory is a crucial area that needs to be fully realized, and I look forward to seeing further developments in this field that will shed light on our true nature...

Bitcoin is deeply feminine, expressed in numbers and is safe.
items.summary: Sure bitcoin is a store of value, and will become a medium of exchange...but the most powerful function of the bitcoin blockchain (in this very moment) is that it allows the capacity for humans to share and deliver a message.
items.body_excerpt:
Sure bitcoin is a store of value, and will become a medium of exchange...but the most powerful function of the bitcoin blockchain (in this very moment) is that it allows the capacity for humans to share and deliver a message. The fact that the message is recorded on an individual unit of currency can be perceived as either a gift or a curse. I choose to look at it as a gift. 

This function can never be erased or deleted. The message is stored forever. Lost maybe, but always in existence to be rediscovered. Never to be controlled. And any attempts at control won't succeed or survive. For sure, there'll be storms but they'll pass. 

The message I want to share and inscribe is my truth. The ancient texts are true. Cannabis awakened Kundalini in me. The combination of sex and cannabis was transcendent. It was the first time that I came face to face with my deep flaws but also the moment I rediscovered profound levels of bliss and joy that completely changed the trajectory of my life. 

Cannabis is medicine in that it restores function of the highly sensitive nerves in the cervix, but it goes beyond medicine into teaching. Because restoration of a highly sensitive area of the body comes with a heart opening life - and a willingness to feel. 

I called cannabis in to my life because I was unknowingly (but paradoxically knowing) seeking a teacher. A teacher with no agenda, and no past that was filtering the human perception. The plant which also teaches me that everything and everyone is a teacher and to be a student of the present moment always. I had no idea that Id be led down this path...but here i am recording my truth to be stored forever. 

Bitcoin is deeply feminine, expressed in numbers and is safe.

Karen Mojica - Tokin' Women

items.body_excerpt:
I Have Found The One Whom My Soul Loves

Noticing

“Her presence commanded attention, a queen in her own right, radiating strength and grace.”
“She had a spirit that soared, defying gravity with every step she took.”
“She wasn't looking for a knight. She was looking for a sword.”
“She had the courage to defy expectations, to break free from the chains that sought to confine her.”
“But the beauty of a woman must be seen from in her eyes.
Because that is the doorway to her heart, the place where love resides.”
“And her heart was a secret garden, and the walls were very high.”

Seeing

“She carried within her a symphony of emotions, each note singing of strength and vulnerability.”
“She was like the moon—part of her was always hidden away.”
“She was beautiful, but not like those girls in the magazines. She was beautiful for the way she thought….No, she wasn't beautiful for something as temporary as her looks. She was beautiful, deep down to her soul.”

Sharing

“She had a soul as deep as the ocean, where dreams and mysteries swirled in harmony”
“Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.”
“Her heart carried the weight of the world, yet it beat with an unwavering determination to make a difference.”
“Her strength was not in her muscles, but in the fire that burned within her soul.”
“She was a constellation of resilience, each star a testament to her unwavering spirit.”

Gazing

“She possesses a radiant soul, pure and bright, / A beauty that shines with heavenly light”
“She possessed a quiet strength, a resilience that could weather any storm.”
“For she is wise, if I can judge of her, And fair she is, if that mine eyes be true.”
“Her eyes, windows to a world unseen, / Where love and kindness eternally convene”

Falling

“Her smile, a secret elixir of mirth and grace, / Unveiling a joy that time cannot erase”
“She is both a masterpiece and a work in progress”
“She is a symphony of resilience and beauty, a melody that lingers in the hearts of those who know her”
“A gentle strength, a quiet grace, she carries herself with timeless elegance”
“In her presence, the world finds solace and serenity”
“She possesses a beauty with a regal air,/ An inner joy that makes hearts aware”
I think I’m falling in love with the love of my life.

Walking

“She seems a part of joyous Spring, / –She shines with a grace like a sunlit field, / 
A beauty that captivates, forever revealed…A creature of the sun”
“Her voice was like the sound of blended flutes”
Even when I saw her resting, her measured breathing, I perceived beauty and wanted to kiss her.
Her absence noticed, my arms had ache
“Her presence lingers, A vision of grace, like a blossoming vine”
“She walks in beauty, like the night /Of cloudless climes and starry skies”

Declaring

“I have found the one whom my soul loves.”

“I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.”
 I will always love you.
“Here is my hand, the premises observed, your will by my performance shall be served.”
“My love for you is a journey; starting at forever and ending at never.”

“I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine.”

items.title: Creation is the ultimate act of unconditional love.
items.summary: All we can do is love in the moment. Even when it feels hard, cannabis teaches the art of letting go and loving. The intensity of the life experience is expansion. Being present with the intensity is a powerful way to come back to love.
items.body_excerpt:
All we can do is love in the moment. Even when it feels hard, cannabis teaches the art of letting go and loving. The intensity of the life experience is expansion. Being present with the intensity is a powerful way to come back to love. Liberation is found within the body, which frees the mind. Because that's the only absolute in the universe, and expressed through language, numbers, matter. Symbols are everywhere around us. To welcome the pain, the fear, the imperfection, the simple, the elimination of complexity. To love the expression mirrored back to us to understand ourselves to the point where the form is produced from the formless. 

To swim in the realm of possibility, pure creation, and coming back up to surface. And loving all that is, exactly where we are in the moment. To love the humaness of me. And to project love. listening through the body with more than the ears. to listen is to receive. from god, goddess, the creator, the energy of greatness, and acknowledging that we are all just a channel for expression.

Creation is the ultimate act of unconditional love. 
To express and to play the game of life. and to have fun. and to be joyful. to surrender to the mystery, and walk with God. To bring your passion to reality. To being a part of the creation of a new form of money, inscribed with peace, prosperity, beauty, imperfection, generosity, transparency, openness, freedom, compassion, union, abundance, and unconditional love for all that is. 

The perfect polarity of the feminine and masculine that is bitcoin. 

To love creation. 

Cannabis - an unconditionally loving teacher.

items.title: There's nothing I love more than receiving love from cannabis and inscribing this love onto bitcoin, sat by sat!
items.summary: Bitcoin is a reflection of the greatness of humanity expressed in the form of money. Humans working together for a higher purpose. Our collective relationship with money is healing.
items.body_excerpt:
Bitcoin is a reflection of the greatness of humanity expressed in the form of money. Humans working together for a higher purpose. Our collective relationship with money is healing. 

It's an exciting time to be alive for an opportunity to be involved in the creation of a new form of money. And to watch the unfolding of it, where it's going, the future of which is far beyond my comprehension - is worth the volatility that comes with the journey. 

Before the intellectualisation of it is the feeling. Conception begins in the womb, travelling up to the heart and translated by the mind through pictures, symbols, language, numbers, and thought. Cannabis allows to perceive the synchronicities that light up our individual path. 

Thank you cannabis for being one of the greatest guides for humanity (if we're prepared to listen), teaching us to drop into that state of unconditional love and to trust in the perfection of time. 

There's nothing I love more than receiving love from cannabis and inscribing this love onto bitcoin, sat by sat! 

Karen Mojica - Tokin' Women

items.title: 𝕐: Mark these words:
items.summary:
𝕐: Mark these words:

Being able to inscribe something meaningful on the #Bitcoin chain for a few dollars or less is an absolute steal.
items.body_excerpt:
𝕐: Mark these words:

Being able to inscribe something meaningful on the #Bitcoin chain for a few dollars or less is an absolute steal. 

Think about it: You are paying a few dollars to store something FOREVER without CENSORSHIP on what will become the decentralized repository for the world's most important public information. 

That thing you store could be namespace handle, an article, an announcement, alpha, a position, a declaration, a tribute, an obit, a poem, or a book... Whatever YOU think is important enough to store for this and/or future generations. 

The future of Bitcoin could be a modern Library of Alexandria that cannot be looted, sacked, or burned down. 

We are at an incredible moment where we can choose our role in this transformation. 

Big ups to @rodarmor @leonidas @TO @chainracingclub and many more for leading the charge. I'm just coming up to speed in the past several months. Looking forward to contributing with Meta-Ordinal theory and Ordweb, an ordinals browser that implements meta protocols. Ok, back to building. 

#Ordinals #ordinalsBTC 

Also inscribed on Bitter and Twitter.

Message:

*Important announcement*

New project from BitArt coming soon.

First of all, thank you to all the creators!

BitArt inscriptions have been trending on ord.io

The new project is a first of its kind, fully on-chain Comgenerative Art project.

Every artwork in the new collection will be generated from the original code inscribed by you, creating a visually distinct, unexpected result.

items.title: Jesus and cannabis.
items.summary:
Jesus and cannabis. 

Jesus was the man. A true, living embodiment of love...and I'm pretty sure he had a relationship with cannabis. A plant that teaches us to understand ourselves, gifting us with self-forgiveness and self-compassion.
items.body_excerpt:
Jesus and cannabis. 

Jesus was the man. A true, living embodiment of love...and I'm pretty sure he had a relationship with cannabis. A plant that teaches us to understand ourselves, gifting us with self-forgiveness and self-compassion. 

Jesus would've spent so much time in meditation and connecting with the creator, creation, the emptiness and nothingness - the space of non-existence, yet limitless potential. And we can enter into this space with cannabis. A plant that connects us to something far greater than the individual self. The plant of connection. The plant of well-being. Calming and relaxing, yet energising and enhancing where the body is talking to the mind and the mind talking to the body. 

She's an amplifier, and if we're individually navigating our wounds and in a state of emotional pain (I know by what I'm projecting) we have to be prepared to face off with our fears at some highly visceral levels - resisting the urge to run away until it melts away into non-resistance. 

A relationship with cannabis is a relationship of the heart. She'll show you that your strength is found within your sensitivity, and the courage of stepping forward into complete uncertainty is the only way, feeling your way through life and welcoming in every experience. 

I'm on team cannabis. 

Karen Mojica - Tokin' Women.

items.title: May our thrill in crafting this message mirror your excitement in discovering it.
items.summary:
May our thrill in crafting this message mirror your excitement in discovering it.

Writing messages on the blockchain is not just a modern practice; it's a timeless method that began with Satoshi Nakamoto's message in the very first block.
items.body_excerpt:
May our thrill in crafting this message mirror your excitement in discovering it.

Writing messages on the blockchain is not just a modern practice; it's a timeless method that began with Satoshi Nakamoto's message in the very first block. Yet at the same time, we find ourselves not merely choosing but being compelled to communicate with you in this way.

A mere few hours after inscribing Orbinals, we came across attempts to impersonate us on Twitter, which compelled us to inscribe an uncommon alert. Soon after we inscribed this alert, a deceptive party cleverly mimicked our style and forged a fraudulent message, sending it to the same Bitcoin address where our uncommon alert resides. We are grateful to the community for their quick dissemination of the warning, and we extend our gratitude to the experts for their prompt action in invalidating this deceptive attempt.

This incident not only highlighted the strength and integrity of the community but also revealed a profound truth. Shifted on-chain, the deceiver found less room to maneuver, a clear demonstration of Bitcoin's core principles of trustless interactions and verifiable integrity.

As Orbinals moves to its next chapter, we seek to establish links with you. Join us in the 'Orbinals: The Stardust Identity' event. The name may be grand, but the process is simple, and our SequentialGalacticTransmitter, which merely reuses existing functions, may be able to assist you in achieving this personal declaration in space.

1. **Witness**: Visit */sat/50050000000000*.
2. **Scrawl**: Replace the 'Your payload' field with an unbounded declaration of wisdom's whispers, creative sparks, or any whimsical etchings; create a celestial symphony unique to your existence.
3. **Link**: Replace the placeholder '<inscription_id>' in '/content/<inscription_id>' with the Inscription ID (a lengthy string of hexadecimal characters) of another declaration. Or just change entire '/content/<inscription_id>' to either "root", "void", "dust", "none", or "zero" (without quotes). The cosmos echos louder in a constellation of linked inscriptions.
4. **Honor**: Keep 'Orbinals: The Stardust Identity' untouched in the third text box, as it serves as the linkage tag for this event.
5. **Validate**: Click 'Craft'. Given correct inputs, HTML code is generated and a preview of the resulting page becomes accessible. Copy the HTML code for later use. Encountered an error? Modify and retry.
6. **Inscribe**: Inscribe the copied HTML onto any Satoshi of your choice.
7. **Share**: Tweet your inscription with the hashtags #Orbinals #TheStardustIdentity to create a loose association with your off-chain identity, enough for our current needs.

See examples: */sat/altrettanto*, */sat/herecooking*.

Returning to our roots, we are dropping a few Orbinals back into the dark forest of Satoshi hunt, perhaps to ignite a shot or two. Check */sat/1705588750000000* and */sat/1706696250000000*.

Stay tuned as we reinscribe the */sat/keymessages* for our next move. Like a seedling reaching for the sun, we're embarking on a path filled with potential. Stay alert to misinformation, and be part of our growth.

items.body_excerpt:
En 2017, j'ai débuté mon voyage dans le monde complexe et fascinant de la finance.

Nous sommes maintenant en 2023, et même si je ne suis pas encore libre financièrement, je suis incroyablement fier de moi.

La persévérance et la discipline que j'ai démontrées depuis que j'ai créé mon portefeuille DCA au sommet de la crypto le 04.08.2021 sont inégalées.

Malgré la chute drastique du marché, j'ai continué à investir de manière disciplinée, sans jamais me laisser abattre par les fluctuations temporaires.

L'année 2022 a été un véritable test pour moi, avec une chute de 75% du marché et mon portefeuille qui a plongé de 95%.

Cependant, malgré ces défis, je suis toujours debout, toujours en vie, et plus que jamais déterminé.

J'ai survécu à la tempête, et cela me rend encore plus fort.

Je crois fermement que les meilleures choses sont encore à venir.

La chute n'est qu'une préparation pour l'ascension, et je suis prêt pour cette ascension.

Je continuerai à m'accrocher, à apprendre et à grandir, sachant que chaque jour me rapproche de mes objectifs financiers.

C'est un voyage, pas une destination, et chaque pas, même petit, compte.

Alors, j'avance avec confiance et anticipation, prêt à accueillir les opportunités que l'avenir me réserve.

₿es Capital

Twitter: (0xBes)

Magical Prose

I lay these words down for you
No one in particular,
Just you the listener

The magic is in your heart
Knowing it,
Truly makes you smart

No one can take away your creativity 
If they don’t kill your spirit
You just have to set it free

The magic is in your soul
Feeling it,
Makes you feel whole 

Let your magic out
Embrace it,
Don’t succumb to the doubt

The magic is in you
The creativity is in you
Now do what you have to. 

I.M.Rosas
1/10/2023

items.body_excerpt:
Famous Poet

I may be famous after my death
Probably not til long after my last breath 
Some may talk about me being a poet
Others may say they didn’t even know it

I never thought that I was creative
Some of you may consider this relative
Until the Art crawled from out of me
And filled me with lots of glee 

Filled me with many different emotions 
Happiness & sadness, internal commotion 
Struggles and turmoil
Just another thing to foil 

Beat it and win
But don’t go too far and sin 
Practice compassion 
Put on that fake smile and grin

Everyone has art in them
Inside of them a hidden gem
You just have to seek out and find it
But don’t get overconfident & blind of it

Remember to always be creating 
And try to never be hating 
Find your art & you too could be famous 
Like most greats, after your death & shameless 

I want you to create
Otherwise you are tempting fate
Let your art out
Or it will handicap & debilitate 

Set your soul free
As I have done to me
And you shall see
This is the only way, it can be. 

I.M.Rosas
11/4/2022

I Miss Being Your Friend 

Hey, I hope you have a great day.
Have lots of fun & time to play. 
I miss being your friend. 
Back then, the fun would never end. 

I know that you’ve gone through,
A lot of tough stuff.
Stuff that makes you blue,
But a little more tough.
items.body_excerpt:
I Miss Being Your Friend 

Hey, I hope you have a great day.
Have lots of fun & time to play. 
I miss being your friend. 
Back then, the fun would never end. 

I know that you’ve gone through,
A lot of tough stuff.
Stuff that makes you blue,
But a little more tough. 

Life can be challenging for sure.
Brain on repeat, I thought I had the cure.
I keep telling myself, stop missing her. 
Be strong Merr, you’re better than you were. 

We can grow or we can fade. 
We can know or we can be jaded. 
I don’t know what you’re thinking,
But the place in my heart for you is not shrinking. 

I’m not gonna call it love. 
I’m not going to call it lust. 
What I will do, is always be your friend.
If that’s what you want too, then trust. 

7/28/2023
I.M.Rosas

items.body_excerpt:
𝕐: Theory 101
A new standard for a Bitcoin Metaverse. It takes advantage of the nature of data's unique ability to be parsed from multiple angels.

Contents
Bitmap Theory
What is Bitmap?
How Does Bitmap Work?
The Importance of Bitcoin Block Ownership
Satoshi Blocks and Their Significance
Building the Open Metaverse
Join the Revolution

Bitmap Theory
Welcome to Bitmap, a transmutational metaverse standard tapping into the Bitcoin Blockchain. Leveraging the Ordinals theory and Bitmap theory, Bitmap offers a groundbreaking way to ascribe claims unto consensual geospatial canvas real estate across a timechain tapestry known as Bitcoin. It's a new frontier in the world of decentralized digital ownership and a new understanding of Metaverse.

spaces_9fDlGOfpRFPPAliJEllt_uploads_4RsuS3Li0IH1dWgtEi52_Bitoshi.webp

What is Bitmap?
Bitmap is a consensus standard that allows anybody to claim the geospatial digital real estate of a Bitcoin Block. This process is achieved by being the first to inscribe blocknumber.bitmap unto a Satoshi using Ordinal Bitmap Inscriptions. This process is equitable and decentralized, transmuting any Bitcoin Block into a part of the Metaverse at the cost of energy.

How Does Bitmap Work?
With Bitmap, any block on the Bitcoin blockchain can be inscribed, making it an integral part of the Metaverse. Platforms can parse this Block Data into the 3D realm and grant build access to block owners, creating a new paradigm for open-source development.

The Importance of Bitcoin Block Ownership
Ownership of Bitcoin Blocks in the Bitmap standard brings with it a range of possibilities. Owners can inscribe transactions as parcels on their own blocks, effectively fractionalizing a block and making it possible to distribute parts of it to a wider community. This means that block owners can become active contributors to the Metaverse, offering a platform for building upon their blocks and creating vibrant, community-driven spaces.

Satoshi Blocks and Their Significance
Among the available blocks are a number of "Satoshi blocks", those mined by Satoshi Nakamoto in the early days of Bitcoin. These carry a particular historical significance, marking the inception of the Bitcoin blockchain. Owning a Satoshi block is a unique way of holding a piece of Bitcoin history.

Building the Open Metaverse
At Bitmap, our vision extends beyond the present. The proceeds from initial block sales will be invested in developing the next layer of tools on the Bitmap standard, laying the groundwork for a world built upon these unique digital spaces. Our roadmap includes the open-source development of the standard, and consensus, working closely with platforms looking to build on in this standard.

Join the Revolution
We invite you to join us in this exciting journey towards building a truly open Metaverse. Whether you're a builder, a visionary, or simply a Bitcoin enthusiast, there's a place for you in the Bitmap community. Get involved today and help shape the future of the Bitcoin Metaverse.
 
 - BITOSHI BLOCKAMOTO

{"p":".bitter","username":"bible.bitter","op":"post","content":"Holy Bible
New King James Version

JOHN -- Chapter 1
-1- In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
-2- He was in the beginning with God.
-3- All things were made through Him, and without Him nothing was made that was made.
-4- In Him was life, and the life was the light of men.
-5- And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not comprehend it.
-6- There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
-7- This man came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all through him might believe.
-8- He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
-9- That was the true Light which gives light to every man coming into the world.
-10- He was in the world, and the world was made through Him, and the world did not know Him.
-11- He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
-12- But as many as received Him, to them He gave the right to become children of God, to those who believe in His name:
-13- who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
-14- And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth.
-15- John bore witness of Him and cried out, saying, "This was He of whom I said, 'He who comes after me is preferred before me, for He was before me.' "
-16- And of His fullness we have all received, and grace for grace.
-17- For the law was given through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
-18- No one has seen God at any time. The only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, He has declared Him.
-19- Now this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"
-20- He confessed, and did not deny, but confessed, "I am not the Christ."
-21- And they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" And he answered, "No."
-22- Then they said to him, "Who are you, that we may give an answer to those who sent us? What do you say about yourself?"
-23- He said: "I am 'The voice of one crying in the wilderness: "Make straight the way of the LORD," ' as the prophet Isaiah said."
-24- Now those who were sent were from the Pharisees.
-25- And they asked him, saying, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
-26- John answered them, saying, "I baptize with water, but there stands One among you whom you do not know.
-27- "It is He who, coming after me, is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose."
-28- These things were done in Bethabara beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
-29- The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
-30- "This is He of whom I said, 'After me comes a Man who is preferred before me, for He was before me.'
-31- "I did not know Him; but that He should be revealed to Israel, therefore I came baptizing with water."
-32- And John bore witness, saying, "I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and He remained upon Him.
-33- "I did not know Him, but He who sent me to baptize with water said to me, 'Upon whom you see the Spirit descending, and remaining on Him, this is He who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.'
-34- "And I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God."
-35- Again, the next day, John stood with two of his disciples.
-36- And looking at Jesus as He walked, he said, "Behold the Lamb of God!"
-37- The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
-38- Then Jesus turned, and seeing them following, said to them, "What do you seek?" They said to Him, "Rabbi" (which is to say, when translated, Teacher), "where are You staying?"
-39- He said to them, "Come and see." They came and saw where He was staying, and remained with Him that day (now it was about the tenth hour).
-40- One of the two who heard John speak, and followed Him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
-41- He first found his own brother Simon, and said to him, "We have found the Messiah" (which is translated, the Christ).
-42- And he brought him to Jesus. Now when Jesus looked at him, He said, "You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas" (which is translated, A Stone).
-43- The following day Jesus wanted to go to Galilee, and He found Philip and said to him, "Follow Me."
-44- Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
-45- Philip found Nathanael and said to him, "We have found Him of whom Moses in the law, and also the prophets, wrote; Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."
-46- And Nathanael said to him, "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."
-47- Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him, and said of him, "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"
-48- Nathanael said to Him, "How do You know me?" Jesus answered and said to him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."
-49- Nathanael answered and said to Him, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"
-50- Jesus answered and said to him, "Because I said to you, 'I saw you under the fig tree,' do you believe? You will see greater things than these."
-51- And He said to him, "Most assuredly, I say to you, hereafter you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man.""}

items.body_excerpt:
titt-"Theory 101
A new standard for a Bitcoin Metaverse. It takes advantage of the nature of data's unique ability to be parsed from multiple angels.

Contents
Bitmap Theory
What is Bitmap?
How Does Bitmap Work?
The Importance of Bitcoin Block Ownership
Satoshi Blocks and Their Significance
Building the Open Metaverse
Join the Revolution

Bitmap Theory
Welcome to Bitmap, a transmutational metaverse standard tapping into the Bitcoin Blockchain. Leveraging the Ordinals theory and Bitmap theory, Bitmap offers a groundbreaking way to ascribe claims unto consensual geospatial canvas real estate across a timechain tapestry known as Bitcoin. It's a new frontier in the world of decentralized digital ownership and a new understanding of Metaverse.

spaces_9fDlGOfpRFPPAliJEllt_uploads_4RsuS3Li0IH1dWgtEi52_Bitoshi.webp

What is Bitmap?
Bitmap is a consensus standard that allows anybody to claim the geospatial digital real estate of a Bitcoin Block. This process is achieved by being the first to inscribe blocknumber.bitmap unto a Satoshi using Ordinal Bitmap Inscriptions. This process is equitable and decentralized, transmuting any Bitcoin Block into a part of the Metaverse at the cost of energy.

How Does Bitmap Work?
With Bitmap, any block on the Bitcoin blockchain can be inscribed, making it an integral part of the Metaverse. Platforms can parse this Block Data into the 3D realm and grant build access to block owners, creating a new paradigm for open-source development.

The Importance of Bitcoin Block Ownership
Ownership of Bitcoin Blocks in the Bitmap standard brings with it a range of possibilities. Owners can inscribe transactions as parcels on their own blocks, effectively fractionalizing a block and making it possible to distribute parts of it to a wider community. This means that block owners can become active contributors to the Metaverse, offering a platform for building upon their blocks and creating vibrant, community-driven spaces.

Satoshi Blocks and Their Significance
Among the available blocks are a number of "Satoshi blocks", those mined by Satoshi Nakamoto in the early days of Bitcoin. These carry a particular historical significance, marking the inception of the Bitcoin blockchain. Owning a Satoshi block is a unique way of holding a piece of Bitcoin history.

Building the Open Metaverse
At Bitmap, our vision extends beyond the present. The proceeds from initial block sales will be invested in developing the next layer of tools on the Bitmap standard, laying the groundwork for a world built upon these unique digital spaces. Our roadmap includes the open-source development of the standard, and consensus, working closely with platforms looking to build on in this standard.

Join the Revolution
We invite you to join us in this exciting journey towards building a truly open Metaverse. Whether you're a builder, a visionary, or simply a Bitcoin enthusiast, there's a place for you in the Bitmap community. Get involved today and help shape the future of the Bitcoin Metaverse.
 
 - BITOSHI BLOCKAMOTO"

It is a protocol for interacting with traded assets like stock indexes ,commodities or anything else.
You can create a prediction for any future price of any traded asset, by creating inscription of the following format.
The essence of the idea and its value in the ability to make predictions by you and other people at the same time. In the future, if your prediction comes true, you will have proof of the prediction linked to your nickname.
Due to the fact that the price of the forecast is not free and depends on sat/vb at the time of creation of the inscription, this increases the meaning of the forecast and allows only interested people to participate in this.
Protocol format
price.date.asset.[username].tradekamoto
price: the price of the asset to be predicted.
date: the final date of the prediction.
asset: name of the selected asset.
username: the name of the creator of the inscription.
Example:"42069.01JAN24.BTC.[tradekamoto.sats].tradekamoto"
